Translation: Congratulations! You hold your little one in your arms for the first time. Somewhere between “What if I break this fragile human, physically or emotionally?” and “Oh, look at those tiny fingers and toes!”, you welcome your child into the world.

Before your child can make a name for themselves, someone must give them one! A good name should sound respectable when they're grown, yet roll off the tongue nicely when you're shouting it in anger. Your spouse has already chosen one, though perhaps you have a better idea. Whether your spouse will appreciate your contribution is another matter entirely.
Then there’s the baptism. Approach the cradle and decide: keep your spouse’s choice, or bestow a name of your own. Best not keep Heaven waiting!
The priest has prepared the holy water, the family has gathered, and a few friends and relatives have been suspiciously nice to you lately. Could they be hoping for the honor of becoming godparents?
The guest of honor, meanwhile, is busy trying to eat their own fist.
Today, your child shall be welcomed into the Christian faith. May the Lord bless them with a long and happy life.
The family has gathered for the reading of the will. Some are still mourning, others have recovered remarkably well, and everyone is eager to hear what the deceased left behind.
Then the notary produces the will, and suddenly everyone is paying attention.

Naturally, all the money goes to you, as the head of the family. Still, you might share a few coins with disappointed relatives, or deliver a heartfelt tribute reminding everyone why you're so well suited to lead the dynasty.

The chapel is filled with familiar faces, nervous smiles, and the rustling of everyone's finest clothes. Some guests have come to celebrate your happiness, others to judge the match, and a few simply couldn't resist a good wedding.
Approach the altar and exchange your vows with your betrothed before God and your assembled families. A sacred union of two hearts, two lives, and, with any luck, two family fortunes.
May the Lord bless your marriage with love and prosperity!
